column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Meta AI writes a short summary of what a post's comments say
Hide Meta AI comment summaries
# context: summary of that switch; the buttons are a post's Like, Comment and Share row
Hides Meta AI's summary at the top of comments and the comment summary under a post's buttons. The comments themselves stay.
column2: Yorumların üstündeki Meta AI özetini ve bir gönderinin düğmelerinin altındaki yorum özetini gizler. Yorumların kendisi kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; Like is the button under a post or a comment
Like only
# context: summary of that switch; the reactions are the row of Love, Haha, Wow and the rest that a long press on Like opens
A long press on Like doesn't open the reactions. A tap still likes.
column2: Beğen'e uzun basmak artık tepkileri açmaz. Bir dokunuş yine beğenir.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; GIF and sticker are two buttons in the box where you type a comment
Hide GIF and sticker buttons
# context: summary of that switch; the comment box is where you type a comment
The comment box loses its GIF and sticker buttons. Typing, photos and posting work as before.
column2: Yorum kutusu GIF ve çıkartma düğmelerini kaybeder. Yazmak, fotoğraf eklemek ve paylaşmak eskisi gibi çalışır.

column1: # context: switch title under Comments; a reply thread is the replies under a comment, which Facebook folds behind View replies
Open every reply thread
# context: summary of that switch; View replies is the link Facebook shows under a comment that has replies
Comments show their replies right away, so there's no View replies to tap.
column2: Yorumlar yanıtlarını hemen gösterir, Yanıtları gör'e dokunman gerekmez.

column1: Hide related groups
A group post's comments end without the Related groups list and its Join buttons.
column2: Bir grup gönderisinin yorumları, İlgili gruplar listesi ve Katıl düğmeleri olmadan biter.

column1: # context: row title under Comments that opens Facebook's own settings; reaction counts are the numbers next to the reactions on a post
Hide reaction counts
# context: summary of that row; Preferences and Reaction preferences are the names Facebook's own settings use
Facebook has its own setting for this. Open Facebook's settings, then Preferences and Reaction preferences.
column2: Facebook'un bunun için kendi ayarı var. Facebook ayarlarını aç, ardından Tercihler ve Tepki tercihleri'ne git.

column1: # context: message shown when Facebook's own settings could not be opened from that row
Facebook's settings didn't open. You'll find Reaction preferences in its Settings, under Preferences.
column2: Facebook ayarları açılmadı. Tepki tercihleri, Facebook Ayarları'nda Tercihler altında.

column1: # context: title of the list of comment orders, and of its dialog
Comment order
# context: entry of that list: the order Facebook's servers pick, which is what happens without Hushfacebook
Facebook's choice
# context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Most relevant
# context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
Newest
# context: entry of that list; Facebook's own name for this order in the sort menu of a post's comments
All comments
# context: summary of the list when Facebook's choice is picked; Most relevant is Facebook's own name for that order
Comments open in the order Facebook picks, which is usually Most relevant.
column2: Yorumlar Facebook'un seçtiği sırayla açılır. Bu genellikle En alakalı sıralamasıdır.

column1: # context: summary of the list; %1$s is one of the order names above, as Facebook's sort menu shows it
A post's comments open with %1$s picked in their sort menu, where the post offers it.
column2: Bir gönderinin yorumları, gönderi bunu sunuyorsa sıralama menüsünde %1$s seçili olarak açılır.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order to Facebook's choice
Comments will open in the order Facebook picks.
# context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that sets the comment order; %1$s is one of the order names above
Comments will open with %1$s picked in their sort menu.
column2: Yorumlar, sıralama menüsünde %1$s seçili olarak açılacak.

column1: # context: switch title under Search; the ads Facebook puts between search results
Hide sponsored search results
# context: summary of that switch
Hides ads between your search results. The results you searched for stay.
column2: Arama sonuçlarınız arasındaki reklamları gizler. Aradığınız sonuçlar kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the ads between the posts on a person's profile or a Page
Hide sponsored profile posts
# context: summary of that switch; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Hides ads between posts on someone's profile or a Page. Their own posts stay.
column2: Birinin profilindeki veya bir Sayfadaki gönderilerin arasındaki reklamları gizler. Kendi gönderileri kalır.

column1: # context: what stays in while Hushfacebook is paused, followed by the patch name in brackets; the row in Facebook's own Menu that opens Hushfacebook settings
the settings row in Facebook's Menu
# context: a short message when the Hushfacebook row in Facebook's Menu couldn't open the settings
Hushfacebook settings can't open here. Long-press the Facebook logo instead.
column2: Hushfacebook ayarları burada açılamıyor. Bunun yerine Facebook logosuna basılı tut.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; the row of groups Facebook suggests joining, shown between posts
Hide suggested groups
# context: summary of that switch; Discover more groups is the label of Facebook's own button under that row
Hides the row of groups to join between posts. Posts from groups you're in stay.
column2: Gönderilerin arasındaki katılabileceğiniz gruplar satırını gizler. Üyesi olduğunuz grupların gönderileri kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; Facebook's own header of a row of Stories from people you don't know, shown between posts
Hide "Stories you might like"
Hide Memories in the feed
Hide friend requests in the feed
Hide friends' locations
Hides Memories between posts, like "On this day" and friendship anniversaries. Your Memories page stays.
column2: Gönderilerin arasındaki “Bu gün” gibi anıları ve arkadaşlık yıl dönümlerini gizler. Anılar sayfanız kalır.

column1: Hides friend requests shown between posts. Your requests stay under Friends.
column2: Gönderilerin arasında görünen arkadaşlık isteklerini gizler. İstekleriniz Arkadaşlar bölümünde kalır.

column1: Hides the card between posts that shows where your friends are.
column2: Gönderilerin arasında arkadaşlarınızın nerede olduğunu gösteren kartı gizler.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the Stories tray is the row of Stories at the top of the feed
Hides the row of Stories from people you aren't connected to, between posts. Your friends' Stories and the Stories tray stay.
column2: Gönderilerin arasında, bağlantınız olmayan kişilerin Hikayeler satırını gizler. Arkadaşlarınızın hikayeleri ve Hikayeler çubuğu kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; trending videos Facebook sends as push notifications
Block trending video notifications
# context: summary of that switch; reels are Facebook's short videos
Trending videos and the reels Facebook picked for you stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Trend videolar ve Facebook'un senin için seçtiği reels videoları artık bildirimlerinde görünmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; memories are Facebook's posts from past years on the same day
Block memory notifications
# context: summary of that switch; On this day is the name Facebook gives its memories feature
Facebook's "On this day" memories stop showing up in your notifications.
column2: Facebook'un “Geçmişte Bugün” anıları artık bildirimlerinde görünmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reminders of friends' birthdays
Block birthday notifications
# context: summary of that switch
No more reminders that it's a friend's birthday.
column2: Bir arkadaşının doğum günü olduğunu hatırlatan bildirimler artık gelmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; Page is Facebook's name for a business or public figure's page
Block group and Page highlights
column2: Grup ve Sayfa öne çıkanlarını engelle

column1: # context: summary of that switch; creators are the people and Pages who post videos and posts you follow
Digests of what's going on in groups, Pages and creators you follow stop. Comments, replies and mentions still come through.
column2: Takip ettiğin gruplarda, Sayfalarda ve içerik üreticilerinde olup bitenlerin özetleri gelmez. Yorumlar, yanıtlar ve bahsetmeler gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; People you may know is Facebook's name for its friend suggestions, as in Hide "People you may know"
Block "People you may know"
# context: summary of that switch; friend requests are other notifications, which always come through
Friend suggestions stop showing up in your notifications. Friend requests still come through.
column2: Arkadaş önerileri artık bildirimlerinde görünmez. Arkadaşlık istekleri gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; places near you and weather alerts Facebook sends
Block nearby and weather notifications
column2: Yakındaki yerler ve hava durumu bildirimlerini engelle

column1: # context: summary of that switch
Alerts about places near you and about the weather stop.
column2: Yakınındaki yerler ve hava durumuyla ilgili uyarılar gelmez.

column1: Block account setup reminders
Reminders to finish setting up a Facebook account stop. Login and security alerts still come through.
column2: Bir Facebook hesabının kurulumunu tamamlama hatırlatıcıları gelmez. Giriş ve güvenlik uyarıları gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; group activity is the notifications about new posts and activity in groups you're in
Block group activity notifications
# context: summary of the group activity switch
Notifications about new activity in your groups stop. Comments, replies and mentions in groups still come through.
column2: Gruplarındaki yeni etkinliklerle ilgili bildirimler gelmez. Gruplardaki yorumlar, yanıtlar ve bahsetmeler gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; an event invite is someone inviting you to a Facebook event
Block event invites
# context: summary of the event invites switch
Invites to events stop showing up in your notifications.
# context: switch title under Notifications; a live video is a broadcast someone is streaming right now
Block live video notifications
# context: summary of the live video switch; the ones you asked Facebook for are live notifications you turned on for a person or Page
Notifications that someone is live stop, including the ones you asked Facebook for.
column2: Birinin canlı yayında olduğuna dair bildirimler gelmez, Facebook'tan istediklerin de dahil.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; reactions are likes and the other reaction buttons on posts and comments
Block reaction notifications
# context: summary of the reactions switch
Likes and reactions to your posts and comments stop showing up in your notifications. Comments still come through.
column2: Gönderilerine ve yorumlarına gelen beğeniler ve tepkiler artık bildirimlerinde görünmez. Yorumlar gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: switch title under Notifications; quiet hours is a stretch of the day when the picked notification kinds are blocked
Quiet hours
# context: summary of the quiet hours switch; the switches above are the notification switches, the two times below are the start and end rows
The switches above block their kinds only between the two times below. The rest of the day those kinds come through.
column2: Yukarıdaki anahtarlar türlerini yalnızca aşağıdaki iki saat arasında engeller. Günün geri kalanında bu türler gelmeye devam eder.

column1: # context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours begin
Quiet hours start
# context: row title and list title; the time quiet hours finish
Quiet hours end
# context: title of a note under Notifications, below the switches; what no switch there blocks
What always comes through
# context: text of that note; Android's own settings are the phone's per-app notification categories, which Facebook's server defines
Messages, friend requests, comments, mentions, calls, login alerts and any kind not listed above always arrive. Android's notification settings for Facebook can block more.
column2: Mesajlar, arkadaşlık istekleri, yorumlar, bahsetmeler, aramalar, giriş uyarıları ve yukarıda listelenmeyen her tür her zaman gelir. Android'in Facebook için bildirim ayarları daha fazlasını engelleyebilir.

column1: # context: switch title under Stories; the stories Facebook suggests in the Stories tray from accounts you don't follow
Hide suggested stories
# context: summary of that switch; Suggested is the label Facebook shows under such a story in the tray, and the tray reloads on its own schedule
Shows only friends and followed Pages in the Stories tray. Applies when Facebook next loads the tray.
column2: Hikayeler çubuğunda yalnızca arkadaşları ve takip edilen Sayfaları gösterir. Facebook çubuğu bir sonraki yüklediğinde geçerli olur.

column1: # context: switch title under Marketplace; the ads Facebook puts between the things people sell in Marketplace's feed
Hide sponsored Marketplace listings
Block Instant Games ads
Games you play in Facebook show no ads. A game that asks for one is told there's none, so rewarded ads give no reward.
column2: Facebook'ta oynadığınız oyunlar reklam göstermez. Reklam isteyen bir oyuna hiç reklam olmadığı söylenir, bu yüzden ödüllü reklamlar ödül vermez.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; a boosted listing is one its seller paid Facebook to show to more people
Hides ads and boosted listings in Marketplace's feed and search results. Regular listings stay.
column2: Marketplace akışındaki ve aramasındaki reklamları ve öne çıkarılan ilanları gizler. Normal ilanlar kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; hides posts whose text holds a word or phrase the person listed
Hide posts with words you choose
Hide posts from people, Pages and sites
column2: Kişilerden, sayfalardan ve sitelerden gelen gönderileri gizle

column1: Hides posts by people or Pages on your list below, or linking to sites on it, including shares. Your list stays on this phone unless you export it.
column2: Aşağıdaki listenizdeki kişilerin veya Sayfaların gönderilerini ve listedeki sitelere bağlantı veren gönderileri, paylaşımlar dahil, gizler. Listeniz dışa aktarmadıkça bu telefonda kalır.

column1: People, Pages and sites to hide

One per line, up to %1$d: a name as Facebook shows it, a profile or Page ID, or a site like example.com, which also covers addresses like m.example.com. Capital letters don't matter. A Facebook link works when it has the ID in it.
column2: Her satıra bir tane, en fazla %1$d: Facebook'un gösterdiği şekliyle bir ad, bir profil veya Sayfa kimliği ya da m.example.com gibi adresleri de kapsayan example.com gibi bir site. Büyük harfler önemli değildir. Kimliği içeren bir Facebook bağlantısı çalışır.

column1: One name, id or site per line
column2: Her satıra bir ad, kimlik veya site

column1: %1$d line was left out. A line holds up to %2$d characters, the list up to %3$d lines, and one given twice counts once.
column2: %1$d satır dışarıda bırakıldı. Bir satır en fazla %2$d karakter, liste en fazla %3$d satır alır ve iki kez yazılan bir kez sayılır.

column1: %1$d lines were left out. A line holds up to %2$d characters, the list up to %3$d lines, and one given twice counts once.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the keep list is the second list under it, and a settings file is the one Export settings writes
Hides posts containing a word or phrase from your list below. Words that keep a post win over it. Your words stay on this phone unless you export them.
column2: Aşağıdaki listenizdeki bir sözcük veya ifade içeren gönderileri gizler. Bir gönderiyi tutan sözcükler bunun önüne geçer. Sözcükleriniz dışa aktarmadıkça bu telefonda kalır.

column1: # context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that hide a post
Words to hide
# context: title of the row and dialog holding the list of words and phrases that keep a post even when it has a word to hide
Words that keep a post
# context: message of the Words to hide dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

One word or phrase per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own. Capital letters don't matter, and a phrase matches anywhere in a post's text, even inside longer words.
column2: Her satıra bir sözcük veya ifade, en fazla %1$d satır, her biri %2$d ile %3$d karakter uzunluğunda. Tek bir emoji veya Çince, Japonca ya da Korece karakter tek başına yeterlidir. Büyük harfler önemli değildir ve bir ifade gönderi metninin her yerinde, daha uzun sözcüklerin içinde bile eşleşir.

column1: # context: message of the Words that keep a post dialog; %1$d is how many phrases a list holds (50), %2$d and %3$d the shortest and longest phrase in characters (2 and 60)

A post with any of these stays, even when it also has a word to hide. One per line, up to %1$d lines, each %2$d to %3$d characters long. A single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough on its own.
column2: Bunlardan birini içeren gönderi, gizlenecek bir sözcük de içerse kalır. Her satıra bir tane, en fazla %1$d satır, her biri %2$d ile %3$d karakter uzunluğunda. Tek bir emoji veya Çince, Japonca ya da Korece karakter tek başına yeterlidir.

column1: # context: hint in the empty text box of both word list dialogs
One word or phrase per line
column2: Her satıra bir kelime veya ifade

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, one line left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters
%1$d line was left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: %1$d satır dışarıda bırakıldı. Bir ifade %2$d ile %3$d karakter olmalı, ama tek bir emoji veya Çince, Japonca ya da Korece karakter yeterlidir. İki kez verilen bir kez sayılır.

column1: # context: toast after saving a word list, several lines left out; %2$d and %3$d are the shortest and longest phrase in characters
%1$d lines were left out. A phrase needs %2$d to %3$d characters, but a single emoji or Chinese, Japanese or Korean character is enough. One given twice counts once.
column2: %1$d satır dışarıda bırakıldı. Bir ifade %2$d ile %3$d karakter olmalı, ama tek bir emoji veya Çince, Japonca ya da Korece karakter yeterlidir. İki kez verilen bir kez sayılır.

column1: # context: summary of the Words to hide row while it's empty
No words yet, so no post is hidden.
column2: Henüz kelime yok, bu yüzden hiçbir gönderi gizlenmiyor.

No words yet.

%1$d word or phrase.

%1$d words or phrases.

Both lists together fill %1$d%% of the room they share.

A list holds up to %1$d phrases, and this one has more. Remove some, then save again.
column2: Bir liste en fazla %1$d ifade alır ve bu listede daha fazlası var. Birkaçını silip yeniden kaydet.

Both lists together would fill %1$d%% of the room they share. Remove or shorten some phrases, then save again.
column2: İki liste birlikte paylaştıkları alanın %%%1$d kadarını dolduracak. Bazı ifadeleri silip ya da kısaltıp yeniden kaydet.

column1: # context: added to the Words to hide summary: posts the filter hid since Facebook last started, one
Hid %1$d post since Facebook started.
# context: added to the Words to hide summary: posts the filter hid since Facebook last started, several
Hid %1$d posts since Facebook started.
# context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that empties the list of words to hide
Your list of words to hide will be empty.
# context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the list of words to hide will hold one phrase
Your list of words to hide will hold %1$d word or phrase.
column2: Gizlenecek kelimeler listende %1$d kelime veya ifade olacak.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the list of words to hide will hold several phrases
Your list of words to hide will hold %1$d words or phrases.
column2: Gizlenecek kelimeler listende %1$d kelime veya ifade olacak.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import that empties the keep list
Your list of words that keep a post will be empty.
column2: Gönderiyi tutan kelimeler listen boş olacak.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the keep list will hold one phrase
Your list of words that keep a post will hold %1$d word or phrase.
column2: Gönderiyi tutan kelimeler listende %1$d kelime veya ifade olacak.

column1: # context: sentence in the import preview and the toast after an import; the keep list will hold several phrases
Your list of words that keep a post will hold %1$d words or phrases.
column2: Gönderiyi tutan kelimeler listende %1$d kelime veya ifade olacak.

column1: # context: section title for the settings about writing posts and comments
Writing
# context: switch title under Writing; @ is the at sign that starts a mention and stays as it is
Tag suggestions only after @
# context: summary of that switch; the list is Facebook's list of people to tag, and @ stays as it is
Type @ before Facebook suggests someone to tag in posts or comments. Your text stays unchanged.
column2: Facebook'un gönderi ve yorumlarda etiketlenecek kişi önermesi için @ yazın. Metniniz değişmez.

column1: # context: switch title under Playback; on, a long video you left partway starts again where you left it
Resume long videos
column2: Uzun videolara kaldığın yerden devam et

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the seek bar is the bar under a video you drag to move through it; Reels is Facebook's name for its short videos
Videos over two minutes pick up where you left off. Drag the bar to start elsewhere. Short reels, live videos and ads start as usual.
column2: İki dakikadan uzun videolar kaldığınız yerden devam eder. Başka bir yerden başlamak için çubuğu sürükleyin. Kısa reeller, canlı videolar ve reklamlar her zamanki gibi başlar.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed, right below Hide AI-detected posts; on, posts their creator labelled as AI go too
Also hide posts labeled as AI
column2: Yapay zekâ olarak etiketlenen gönderileri de gizle

column1: Hide Meta AI in the feed
Hides Meta AI cards between posts and cards promoting the Vibes app. People's posts stay, whatever they say about AI.
column2: Gönderilerin arasındaki Meta AI kartlarını ve Vibes uygulamasını tanıtan kartları gizler. İnsanların gönderileri, yapay zeka hakkında ne derse desin kalır.

column1: Hide AI character posts
Hides posts featuring Meta's AI characters, the chatbots people make with Meta AI Studio. Untested on a real feed, so it starts off.
column2: Meta'nın yapay zeka karakterlerini, yani insanların Meta AI Studio ile yaptığı sohbet botlarını içeren gönderileri gizler. Gerçek bir akışta henüz denenmedi, bu yüzden kapalı başlar.

column1: # context: summary of that switch; the AI label is the one Facebook shows next to the poster's name on such posts
Also hides posts their creator labeled as made with AI, not just the ones Facebook detects itself. Untested on a real feed, so it starts off.
column2: Yalnızca Facebook'un kendi tespit ettiklerini değil, yaratıcısının yapay zekayla üretildi olarak işaretlediği gönderileri de gizler. Gerçek bir akışta henüz denenmedi, bu yüzden kapalı başlar.

column1: Return to regular Facebook
Restore the normal tabs at the next restart. Your other settings stay saved.
column2: Bir sonraki yeniden başlatmada normal sekmeleri geri getirir. Diğer ayarlarınız kayıtlı kalır.

column1: Marketplace mode is off. Restart Facebook to restore its normal tabs.
column2: Marketplace modu kapalı. Normal sekmeleri geri getirmek için Facebook'u yeniden başlatın.

column1: Couldn't save the change. Try again.
Marketplace mode chooses the opening tab. Your previous choice stays saved.
column2: Açılış sekmesini Marketplace modu belirler. Önceki seçiminiz kayıtlı kalır.

column1: Restart needed. Marketplace mode will turn on the next time Facebook starts.

# context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the story is marked and waiting to be sent; a second tap takes the mark back
Marked as seen. Tap again to undo.
column2: Görüldü olarak işaretlendi. Geri almak için tekrar dokun.

column1: # context: what TalkBack reads for the eye button once the marked story was sent as seen
Marked as seen and sent
# context: the word lists' dialogs, after their first paragraph: a line between slashes is a regular expression; %1$d is how many a list holds, %2$d the most characters each
A line between slashes, like /gr[ae]y/, is a pattern that can match several spellings (a regular expression). A list holds up to %1$d, each up to %2$d characters.
column2: Eğik çizgiler arasındaki bir satır, örneğin /gr[ae]y/, birkaç yazımla eşleşebilen bir kalıptır (düzenli ifade). Bir liste en fazla %1$d tane tutar, her biri en fazla %2$d karakter.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: a line written between slashes isn't a pattern the app can read; %1$d is the line's number
Line %1$d isn't a pattern Hushfacebook can read. Fix it or remove it, then save again.
column2: %1$d. satır Hushfacebook'un okuyabildiği bir kalıp değil. Düzelt ya da sil, sonra yeniden kaydet.

column1: # context: under a word list being edited, and when its Save is refused: more patterns than a list holds; %1$d is the most a list holds
A list holds up to %1$d patterns, and this one has more. Remove some, then save again.
column2: Bir liste en fazla %1$d kalıp alır ve bu listede daha fazlası var. Birkaçını silip yeniden kaydet.

column1: # context: switch title: hides feed posts whose attachment is a photo or an album
Hide photo posts
# context: switch title: hides feed posts whose attachment is a video
Hide video posts
# context: switch title: hides feed posts that share a link to a website
Hide link posts
# context: switch title: hides short text posts Facebook draws on a colored background
Hide posts on a colored background
# context: summary of the Hide photo posts switch
Hides posts with a photo or album, including shares.
column2: Fotoğraf veya albüm içeren gönderileri, paylaşımlar dahil, gizler.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide video posts switch
Hides posts with a video, including shares. Reels in the feed have their own switch.
column2: Video içeren gönderileri, paylaşımlar dahil, gizler. Akıştaki reellerin kendi anahtarı var.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide link posts switch
Hides posts that share a link to a website, with its preview card.
column2: Bir web sitesine bağlantı paylaşan gönderileri, önizleme kartıyla birlikte gizler.

column1: # context: summary of the Hide posts on a colored background switch
Hides short posts shown as big text on a colored background.
column2: Renkli bir arka planda büyük yazı olarak görünen kısa gönderileri gizler.

column1: # context: switch title in Privacy: asks for the phone's own screen lock before Facebook shows
Lock Facebook
# context: summary of the Lock Facebook switch; the time below is the Lock after row under it
Facebook asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock at startup and when you return after the time below. Your phone needs a screen lock.
column2: Facebook, açılırken ve aşağıdaki süreden sonra geri döndüğünüzde parmak izi, yüz veya ekran kilidi ister. Telefonunuzda ekran kilidi olmalı.

column1: # context: toast when Lock Facebook is turned on and the phone has no screen lock to ask for
Set a screen lock in your phone's settings first, so Facebook has something to ask for.
column2: Facebook'un isteyebileceği bir şey olsun diye önce telefonunun ayarlarından bir ekran kilidi ayarla.

column1: # context: title of the row and list that picks how long Facebook may be away before it locks
Lock after
# context: Lock after choice: Facebook locks the moment you leave it
As soon as you leave
# context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: a minute away
1 minute
# context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: five minutes away
5 minutes
# context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: fifteen minutes away
15 minutes
# context: Lock after choice, and the %1$s of the lock sentences: an hour away
1 hour
# context: summary of the Lock after row when it locks the moment you leave
Facebook locks as soon as you leave it.
# context: summary of the Lock after row; %1$s is a time such as 5 minutes
Facebook locks once you've been away for %1$s.
# context: what a settings import changes: the lock will happen the moment Facebook is left
With Lock Facebook on, it will lock as soon as you leave it.
column2: Facebook'u kilitle açıkken, ayrılır ayrılmaz kilitlenecek.

column1: # context: what a settings import changes; %1$s is a time such as 5 minutes
With Lock Facebook on, it will lock once you've been away for %1$s.
column2: Facebook'u kilitle açıkken, %1$s uzak kaldığında kilitlenecek.

column1: # context: title of Android's fingerprint, face or screen lock prompt that Lock Facebook shows
Unlock Facebook
# context: title on the screen that covers Facebook until the screen lock check passes
Facebook is locked
# context: text under it on the cover
Use your fingerprint, face or screen lock to open it.
column2: Açmak için parmak izini, yüzünü ya da ekran kilidini kullan.

column1: # context: button on the cover that asks for the screen lock again
Unlock
# context: title of the row and list that picks how large Facebook's text is, as a share of the phone's font size
Text size
# context: Text size choice for no change: Facebook's text stays at the size the phone's font size setting gives it
As Facebook has it
# context: summary of the Text size row at its default
Facebook's text is the size your phone's font size setting gives it.
column2: Facebook'taki metin, telefonunun yazı tipi boyutu ayarının verdiği boyutta.

column1: # context: summary of the Text size row; %1$s is a percentage such as 115%
Facebook's text is %1$s of the size your phone's font size setting gives it. Restart Facebook to see the change.
column2: Facebook'un yazısı, telefonunuzun yazı boyutu ayarının verdiği boyutun %1$s kadarıdır. Değişikliği görmek için Facebook'u yeniden başlatın.

column1: # context: what a settings import changes: Facebook's text goes back to the phone's font size
Facebook's text will be the size your phone's font size setting gives it.
column2: Facebook'taki metin, telefonunun yazı tipi boyutu ayarının verdiği boyutta olacak.

column1: # context: what a settings import changes; %1$s is a percentage such as 115%
Facebook's text will be %1$s of the size your phone's font size setting gives it.
column2: Facebook'taki metin, telefonunun yazı tipi boyutu ayarının verdiği boyutun %1$s kadarı olacak.

Accent color
# context: Accent color choice and color name: Facebook's own blue, no change
Facebook blue

Teal

Green

Purple

Pink

Red

Indigo
# context: Accent color choice, a yellow-orange
Amber

Material You theme is in this build and picks Facebook's colors, so this has no effect.
column2: Material You teması bu sürümde var ve Facebook'un renklerini seçiyor, bu yüzden bunun bir etkisi yok.

column1: # context: summary of the Accent color row at its default
Links, buttons, switches and the selected tab keep Facebook's blue.
column2: Bağlantılar, düğmeler, anahtarlar ve seçili sekme Facebook'un mavisini korur.

column1: # context: summary of the Accent color row; %1$s is a color name such as Teal
Links, buttons, switches and the selected tab use %1$s instead of Facebook's blue. Restart Facebook to see the change. If the Material You theme is added, it takes over.
column2: Bağlantılar, düğmeler, anahtarlar ve seçili sekme Facebook'un mavisi yerine %1$s kullanır. Değişikliği görmek için Facebook'u yeniden başlatın. Material You teması eklenmişse o geçerli olur.

column1: # context: what a settings import changes: Facebook goes back to its own blue
Facebook will keep its own blue.
# context: what a settings import changes; %1$s is a color name such as Teal
If your patched Facebook includes Accent color, Facebook's blue will be %1$s.
column2: Yamalı Facebook'unuz Vurgu rengini içeriyorsa Facebook'un mavisi %1$s olacak.

column1: # context: switch title under Chats; photos and videos sent from a chat inside Facebook go out as the originals
Send photos and videos at original quality
column2: Fotoğrafları ve videoları orijinal kalitede gönder

column1: # context: description of that switch; the 20 and 25 MB limits are where Facebook's own shrinking takes over again; a video with a location tag is shrunk by Facebook, which drops the tag
Sends photos and videos in Facebook chats at full quality. Photos lose location and camera details. Big files and videos with a location tag are still shrunk.
column2: Facebook sohbetlerinde fotoğrafları ve videoları tam kalitede gönderir. Fotoğraflar konum ve kamera bilgisini kaybeder. Büyük dosyalar ve konum etiketli videolar yine küçültülür.

column1: # context: button in the Words to hide editor that opens a list of ready-made word lists for common topics
Add a topic pack

Politics

Elections
# context: topic pack name: words about cryptocurrency
Crypto
# context: topic pack name: words about sports
Sports

Celebrity gossip

Weight loss ads

Giveaways and engagement bait

Added %1$d word from %2$s.

Added %1$d words from %2$s.

%1$d was already in the list.

The list is full, so the rest weren't added.

The list is full, so nothing was added.

Every word from %1$s is already in the list.
# context: last sentence of the topic pack toast: the words are only typed into the editor until Save
Tap Save to keep the list.
# context: row title and dialog title under News feed: posts with more reactions than the chosen count are hidden
Hide posts with more reactions than

%1$s reactions
# context: summary of the reaction ceiling row while it is off
Posts stay however many reactions they have.
column2: Gönderiler kaç tepki alırsa alsın kalır.

column1: # context: summary of the reaction ceiling row while a count is chosen; %1$s is a number such as 5,000
Hides posts with more than %1$s reactions, read from the count Facebook shows under a post.
column2: %1$s tepkiden fazlası olan gönderileri gizler. Sayı, Facebook'un gönderinin altında gösterdiği sayıdan okunur.

column1: # context: settings import preview and result: the file turns the reaction ceiling off
The feed won't hide posts for how many reactions they have.
column2: Akış, gönderileri tepki sayısına göre gizlemeyecek.

column1: # context: settings import preview and result: the file sets a reaction ceiling; %1$s is a number such as 5,000
The feed will hide posts with more than %1$s reactions.
column2: Akış, %1$s tepkiden fazlası olan gönderileri gizleyecek.

column1: # context: switch title under News feed; it keeps posts you scrolled past out of the feed on later loads
Hide posts you've already seen
# context: description of that switch; Facebook decides what counts as seen, the list never leaves the phone; turning the switch off empties the list
Posts you've scrolled past stay out of the feed when it loads again. The list stays on this phone. Turning this off empties it.
column2: Üzerinden kaydırdığınız gönderiler akış yeniden yüklendiğinde görünmez. Liste bu telefonda kalır. Bunu kapatmak listeyi boşaltır.

column1: # context: title of the row under that switch that picks how many days a seen post stays hidden
Keep them hidden for
# context: choice in that row
1 day
# context: choice in that row
3 days
# context: choice in that row
7 days
# context: choice in that row
30 days
# context: summary of that row; %1$s is a time such as 7 days
A post you've scrolled past stays out of the feed for %1$s.
column2: Üzerinden geçtiğin bir gönderi %1$s boyunca akışın dışında kalır.

column1: # context: title of the row that empties the list of seen posts
Forget seen posts
# context: description of that row
Empties the list of posts you've seen, so they can show up again.
column2: Görülen gönderilerin listesini boşaltır, böylece gönderiler yeniden görünebilir.

column1: # context: toast after tapping that row
Seen posts forgotten.
# context: what a settings import changes; %1$s is a time such as 7 days
Posts you've seen will stay hidden for %1$s.
# context: settings row under Pause, backup and diagnostics that opens Facebook's own Whitehat screen; Whitehat is Facebook's name for its security researcher program, keep it
Facebook's Whitehat settings
# context: summary of that row when Facebook's screen is on the phone

Facebook's own screen for security testing. It can make Facebook trust security certificates you installed, or send its data through a proxy (a go-between server). Hushfacebook doesn't change anything there.
column2: Facebook'un güvenlik testleri için kendi ekranı. Facebook'un yüklediğiniz güvenlik sertifikalarına güvenmesini veya verilerini bir proxy (aracı sunucu) üzerinden göndermesini sağlayabilir. Hushfacebook orada hiçbir şeyi değiştirmez.

column1: # context: summary of that row when Facebook hasn't downloaded the screen, so the row opens a web page
Facebook hasn't downloaded this screen to this phone, so a tap opens the Whitehat page on the web instead.
column2: Facebook bu ekranı bu telefona indirmedi, bu yüzden dokunduğunda web'deki Whitehat sayfası açılır.

column1: # context: toast when the Facebook version has no such screen
This Facebook build has no Whitehat settings screen.
column2: Bu Facebook sürümünde Whitehat ayarları ekranı yok.

column1: Only the first reel waits
With the switch above on, after you play one reel, the reels you swipe to play on their own. The feed, Watch and stories always wait.
column2: Yukarıdaki anahtar açıkken bir reel oynattıktan sonra kaydırdığınız reeller kendiliğinden oynar. Akış, Watch ve hikayeler her zaman bekler.

column1: Slower speeds
Adds 0.1x and 0.25x to the speed menu of reels and of feed and Watch videos, for slowing down a fast moment.
column2: Reellerin ve akış ile Watch videolarının hız menüsüne 0,1x ve 0,25x seçeneklerini ekler; hızlı geçen bir anı yavaşlatmak için.

Share to your story
Share to a group
Share to a Page
Copy link

%1$d switches start off now

After this update, a switch you had on may be off now. Tap to see which.

Now off: %1$s. Turn it back on in its section if you want it. Tap again to hide this note.

Now off: %1$s. Turn back on the ones you want in their sections. Tap again to hide this note.
column2: Artık kapalı: %1$s. İstediklerini bölümlerinden yeniden aç. Bu notu gizlemek için yeniden dokun.

column1: # context: import preview and toast when a settings file empties the list picked under Share sheet items to hide
Your list of share sheet items to hide will be empty.
column2: Paylaşırken gizlenecek öğeler listen boş olacak.

Your list of share sheet items to hide will hold %1$d item.

Your list of share sheet items to hide will hold %1$d items.
column2: Paylaşırken gizlenecek öğeler listende %1$d öğe olacak.

Support Hushfacebook

Buy me a coffee on Ko-fi

Where ads and tracking are blocked
# context: that heading's summary; build means this patched copy of Facebook, switch is a settings toggle
The places Facebook shows ads or reports what you do, and what this build does about each. A line with a switch takes you to it.
column2: Facebook'un reklam gösterdiği ya da ne yaptığınızı bildirdiği yerler ve bu sürümün her biri için yaptıkları. Anahtarı olan bir satır sizi o anahtara götürür.

Ads in the feed

Ads on profiles

Ads in Marketplace

Ads downloaded in advance

Ad tracking

Facebook's ads in other apps

Those apps show their own ads or none, and their rewarded ads may fail.

column1: # context: a line of that list: the usage statistics Facebook uploads in the background
Usage statistics uploads
# context: added to that line's summary: what else holding the uploads stops, and when a change of its switch takes effect
Facebook's on-phone learning jobs stop too, and a change applies after Facebook restarts.
column2: Facebook'un telefondaki öğrenme görevleri de durur ve bir değişiklik Facebook yeniden başladıktan sonra geçerli olur.

Reel watch history

Reels you've already seen may come back.

Blocked since you patched. There's no switch for it.

column1: # context: summary of a line in that list with a switch; %1$s is the switch's name, %2$s the settings page it's on
Its switch is %1$s, in %2$s.
# context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, next to Share sheet items to hide
Hide group buttons in the share sheet
# context: that switch's summary. Send to group and Send separately are the buttons Facebook's share sheet shows when two or more people are picked
Takes away Send to group when you pick two or more people, and the share sheet's own ways to start a new group, so nothing you share makes a group chat by accident. Send separately stays.
column2: İki veya daha fazla kişi seçtiğinde “Gruba gönder” seçeneğini ve paylaşırken yeni grup başlatma yollarını kaldırır, böylece paylaştığın hiçbir şey yanlışlıkla grup sohbeti oluşturmaz. “Ayrı ayrı gönder” kalır.

column1: # context: switch title under Links in Hushfacebook settings, right after Remove tracking from shared links
Share the post's own link
# context: that switch's summary. Copy link is the share sheet item of that name; facebook.com/share/ is a web address and stays as written
Copy link and the share sheet's other link shares give the post's own facebook.com address instead of a facebook.com/share/ link made for that one share.
column2: “Bağlantıyı kopyala” ve paylaşım menüsündeki diğer bağlantı paylaşma yolları, yalnızca o paylaşım için oluşturulan bir facebook.com/share/ bağlantısı yerine gönderinin kendi facebook.com adresini verir.
